result: All five are visibly photographs; no blocking mismatch found.

observations.a18-rba-taylor-2135-glessner-ne: Sepia photographic street-corner view of the long rough-faced stone Glessner facade and steep gable roof; Taylor number 2135 is visible. Matches the oblique-front subject and differs from the stable-end view.
observations.a18-gh-cornell-glessner-rear-c1887: Sepia photographic view of the rough-faced stone stable/coach-house end, gables and large vehicle opening. Its visible form agrees with the Glessner stable-end description.
observations.a18-rba-taylor-1801-kimball-c1895: Sepia photograph of the ornate corner mansion with conical turrets, high roofs and arched porch. Taylor number 19825 is visible; consistent with the Kimball catalog subject.
observations.a18-rba-levy-1812-wheeler: Photograph of a narrow ornate gabled facade with entrance steps and grouped windows. The reproduced print has conspicuous creases and wear, but the facade is readable. No legible address independently establishes identity at thumbnail size; correspondence rests on the catalog and existing reference record.
observations.a16-pullman-det-4a08065: Black-and-white street-corner photograph of the large mansard-roofed Pullman residence, with bare trees and surrounding street. The lower caption identifies the Pullman residence in Chicago; subject/view agree with the catalog.

limitations: Dates and authorship are read from canonical records, not inferred from image appearance.
